missing_evidence: Order service logs/traces showing the internal error cause behind its 500 responses
Order service metrics (error rate, latency, dependency outcomes) during the incident window
candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on POST /v1/checkout. Traces and logs show the gateway's client call to order:8000 failing with 500, so the checkout 502s are propagated downstream failures originating in the order service.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause within the order service (e.g. db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout) is not established; only the 500 origin is bounded.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout 502s correlate with order service 500s on POST /v1/orders across traces and logs; topology confirms gateway->order dependency. The bounded candidate is downstream order-service HTTP 500 propagation. The specific internal fault in order is not yet evidenced, so deeper cause remains open.
